guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with thead/th; wrap in an overflow:auto container with tabindex=0, role=region and an accessible name from the caption; keep cell text legible instead of letting columns shrink below legibility.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: all tables in the shared .table-wrap scroller; the three captioned tables (args, resolved style, compat) carry tabindex=0 role=region aria-labelledby=<caption id> with a :focus-visible outline, and get a min-width so narrow columns scroll rather than wrap one character per line. Exception: no sticky headers or stacked card layout - tables are short (2-5 rows) and the house style uses plain scrollers.

guidanceConsulted.query: embedding cross-origin iframe lazy loading sandbox
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Apply loading=lazy to off-screen iframes; never hide focusable embedded iframes from assistive technology; use figure/figcaption for embedded media.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: below-the-fold showcase iframe has loading=lazy, a descriptive title, figure/figcaption, and the mandatory sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" + referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" pair.

guidanceConsulted.query: long code blocks in article readable on narrow mobile screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Contain long tokens with overflow-wrap: anywhere; avoid fixed heights on text containers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: h1/.lede and inline code use overflow-wrap:anywhere (the H1 contains '::highlight(*)'); pre blocks scroll horizontally (overflow-x:auto) so code is never reflowed.
